request_text:
Execute mission step contract review (software-dev/review).
Step supply_chain_security_review: Require explicit supply-chain evidence (registry authenticity, package freshness, lifecycle-script disposition, Node Active LTS posture, incident/IoC posture) before recommending approval for any change that touches the dependency tree. Advisory in v1 per NFR-003/C-003: this step does not add a new fail-closed transition gate -- the existing "in_progress->for_review" gate above is unchanged -- but silence or an unexamined default is treated as a gap in evidence, not a pass.

Resolved delegations: tactic:supply-chain-install-safety
